Callout.Name: Bail Condition Check
Callout.Message: Report that a person is breaching bail conditions.
Callout.Advisory: Person seen at an address he should not be at.

Script.Line: I have not been near that address. Check the tag.
You can see the tag on my ankle. It has not gone off once.
This is harassment. That is what this is.

Lines.Approach: He is back at the address the bail conditions keep him away from. The complainant is watching him now.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
